scoring_justification: Re-running DFT+U calculations and SCAPS-1D simulations in the verifier sandbox is computationally infeasible; result-level comparison against paper-reported values is the correct tier. Band gaps and PCE are fixed deterministic quantities from the paper's computational procedure, so a symmetric tolerance window (reference_match) is appropriate.

outputs.description: JSON file containing the computed band gaps (eV) and power conversion efficiencies (%). The hidden checker compares each value to a paper‑reported reference with appropriate tolerances and also verifies the required relative ordering: pristine PCE < 3.125% Sn PCE > 4.17% Sn PCE > 6.25% Sn PCE, and Sn 4.17% PCE > Zn 4.17% PCE.

output_contract.notes: Band gaps are compared to hidden reference values with a tolerance of ±0.1 eV; PCE values are compared with a tolerance of ±1% absolute. The relative ordering constraints are also enforced. The intermediate DFT and SCAPS artifacts are not scored.

steps.description: Check each band gap against the paper-reported value within ±0.1 eV.
Check each PCE value against the paper-reported value within ±1% absolute and verify ordering constraints.
